q: How do I calculate emissions per kg of linen in a hotel's own laundry?
title: In-house hotel laundry per kg
short: Add the laundry's steam or boiler fuel, washer, dryer and ironer electricity at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, and any LPG for dryers, then divide by kg of linen washed. A sub-meter or the boiler log shows the laundry's share of hotel energy.

ul: Boiler fuel for steam or hot water used by the laundry.
Electricity for washer extractors, tumble dryers and the flatwork ironer.
LPG or gas if dryers burn it directly.

p: Use a sub-meter where one exists. Otherwise share boiler fuel by steam demand and label the split an estimate in your method note.
Report per kg of linen washed, from the laundry's weighing log. Outsourced laundry is Scope 3 instead.

example.title: Worked example: hotel laundry (one month, illustrative inputs)
lines: Total: 7,167 / 30,000 = 0.239 kg CO2 per kg of linen
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use the laundry sub-meter or boiler log.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
